facts.statement: Take new blood thinner Apixaban 5 mg twice a day at 9 am and 9 pm; if a dose is missed, take it as soon as remembered on the same day, but never take 2 doses together.
facts.label: Apixaban 5 mg: twice a day, 9 am and 9 pm

facts.statement: Take new medicine Metoprolol succinate 25 mg once daily in the morning for heart rate.
facts.label: Metoprolol 25 mg: once a day, morning

facts.statement: Continue taking Atorvastatin 20 mg at bedtime.
facts.label: Atorvastatin: 20 mg at bedtime

facts.statement: Avoid NSAIDs such as ibuprofen and diclofenac for pain, but paracetamol is okay.
facts.label: NSAIDs: avoid ibuprofen and diclofenac

facts.statement: Go to emergency or call 112 if you have black or bloody stools, vomit blood, a severe headache, or a fall with a head injury.
facts.label: Call 112: black or bloody stools, vomiting blood, head injury

facts.statement: Call the clinic if you have a nosebleed longer than 10 minutes, blood in urine, or unusual bruising.
facts.label: Call clinic: nosebleed, blood in urine

facts.statement: Tell any dentist or doctor that you take Apixaban before any procedure.
facts.label: Apixaban: tell dentist or doctor

facts.statement: Have a kidney function blood test on 29 Oct 2026.
facts.label: Kidney blood test: 29 Oct 2026

facts.statement: Attend the cardiology clinic with Dr. Anjali Mehta on 9 Nov 2026 at 11:00.
facts.label: Cardiology clinic: 9 Nov 2026, 11:00

facts.statement: Check pulse daily and call if resting pulse is below 50 or above 110.
facts.label: Pulse: call if below 50, above 110
